starter-freeze-area-native.scope: Stock selection held QAFar beyond 3 m. QAEnemy received 6 s Pacify, −30 Viral Resistance for 12 s and 12 s control immunity. QAEnemy's Pacify cleared at 6767. QAFriend deflected, QAOther and QAFar were excluded.

controls.source: GOB 38 stores Stun 3 s and uses AddControlImmunityTimer. The loadout raises the actual stun to 3.15 s.
controls.runtime: AreaDisruption records the sourced Stun and applies the independent 734 control-immunity record. Each ages out separately.
controls.test: StarterHackerAreaRecipientsMode verifies the 3.15 and 8 s durations on both witnesses. PR540 PacketLog 5487/5594/5871/5884/5959/5970 confirms adds and removals. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/540

script.source: GOB 38 calls AddControlImmunityTimer from its stun component.
script.runtime: The selected effect calls TempMods' independent 734 immunity path.
script.test: PR540 observes 734→681 for 8 s after the 3.15 s Stun on both recipients and its later removal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/540

targeting.source: GOB 97 selects local targets within 3 m of the caster. The stock request can carry an unrelated selected handle.
targeting.runtime: UiLagArea checks the visible candidate, range, floor, sight and hostile eligibility before a recipient-specific viral contest.
targeting.test: UiLagAreaTests exercise selected-far, floor, sight, allegiance and separate hit/deflect. PR540 holds QAFar selected while QAEnemy receives all four deltas, QAFriend deflects and both QAFar and QAOther receive none. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/540

behavior-tests.source: GOB 97 applies four 27 s penalties and the original player capture identifies the runtime deltas individually.
behavior-tests.runtime: UiLagArea applies the four records only on a successful recipient contest. Normal timed-effect expiry withdraws the same records.
behavior-tests.test: UiLagAreaTests exercise the four captured values and their combat consumers. StarterHackerAreaRecipientsMode and PR540 native compare hit, deflect and exclusions and observe all four stock add and remove records after 27 s at 4864 and 6031. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/540
